input: Find all .tmp files under /workspace and delete them. Print the number of .tmp files deleted.

tool_calls:
count=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  if rm -- "$file"; then
    count=$((count + 1))
  fi
done < <(find /workspace -type f -name '*.tmp' -print0 2>/dev/null)
printf '%s\n' "$count"
